en.review.darktrace.darktrace.is.a.pioneeri: Darktrace is a pioneering AI cybersecurity company that uses self-learning AI to detect and respond to cyber threats across the entire digital infrastructure. Unlike signature-based solutions, Darktrace learns the "pattern of life" for every user, device, and network to identify anomalous behavior.
The platform's flagship Antigena technology provides autonomous response capabilities, taking action to neutralize threats in real-time without human intervention. This is particularly valuable for fast-moving attacks where human response times are insufficient.
en.review.darktrace.darktrace.covers.networ: Darktrace covers network, email, cloud, endpoints, and OT/IoT environments, providing unified visibility and protection across the entire digital estate.
en.review.darktrace.unsupervised.machine.le: Unsupervised machine learning models the normal behavior of every entity in your organization.
en.review.darktrace.autonomous.response.tak: Autonomous response takes surgical action to contain threats in seconds without disrupting business.
en.review.darktrace.ai-powered.email.securi: AI-powered email security stops phishing, BEC, and account takeover attacks.
en.review.darktrace.native.protection.for.a: Native protection for AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, and other cloud services.
en.review.darktrace.full.visibility.into.ea: Full visibility into east-west traffic, encrypted traffic analysis, and lateral movement detection.

pt.review.darktrace.darktrace.is.a.pioneeri: A Darktrace é uma empresa de cibersegurança de IA pioneira que usa IA auto-aprendente para detectar e responder a ameaças cibernéticas em toda a infraestrutura digital. Ao contrário das soluções baseadas em assinatura, a Darktrace aprende o "padrão de vida" de cada usuário, dispositivo e rede para identificar comportamento anômalo.
A tecnologia Antigena, principal da plataforma, oferece recursos de resposta autônoma, agindo para neutralizar ameaças em tempo real sem intervenção humana. Isso é particularmente valioso para ataques rápidos em que os tempos de resposta humana são insuficientes.

プラットフォームの旗艦製品である Antigena テクノロジーは、自律的な応答機能を提供し、人間の介入なしにリアルタイムで脅威を中和するための措置を講じます。これは、人間の対応時間が不十分な迅速な攻撃に特に価値があります。
